items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: we got this engagement at the Taunty Athletic Club where we engaged Diddy Stevens

ctx.x: was Jack Lane a non-standing drummer or was he more of an organizer or what that's what Jack was yes

see that's how uh he worked with us he did and we did quite a bit of work and he'd booked the jobs and all of a sudden he got some name plates made for each man calling it Lane's Band this was the Reliance Band that was Giordina, Baquet, Vega, Giblin and Jerosa myself well we didn't like that idea at all and we left him we worked other places and we got this engagement at the Taunty Athletic Club where we engaged Diddy Stevens
were there any outstanding bass drum players for example in the parades
